candidates.source_name: Ephrem the Syrian / Hymns on the Crucifixion
candidates.source_attribution: Ephrem the Syrian, Hymns on the Crucifixion VI.3-5 (NPNF S2 V13). PD.
candidates.draft_body:
Ephrem the Syrian Hymns on the Crucifixion (c. 365 AD)

Moses takes the blood and sprinkles it on the people, saying 'Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.' Ephrem hears in this the very formula that Christ will adopt verbatim at the Last Supper: 'This is the blood of the covenant.' Tewahedo Anaphora reads Ex 24:8 and Mt 26:28 as a single covenantal sentence completed by the Cross.
candidates.reviewer_notes: Curated PD interpretive summary representing the Ethiopian Tewahedo tradition's reading via Ephrem the Syrian, Hymns on the Crucifixion.
